scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@supportflow/shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@supportflow/shared && npm run build --workspace=@supportflow/backend && npm run build --workspace=@supportflow/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@supportflow/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@supportflow/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@supportflow/frontend
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
